1. Create a private mihon-sync repository under your GitHub account. Keep it empty; do not add a README, license, or .gitignore. GitHub may ignore prefilled values, so check the owner, name, and visibility before creating it.
2. Install the Mihon GitHub App and select only mihon-sync. Do not select All repositories. Signing in does not install the App or grant repository access.
3. Return here and recheck. Mihon will verify your account, App installation, repository ID, privacy, and access before offering initialization.
